Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [All Turns] effect also give "[When Attacking] Lose 1 memory" to my level 3 Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. Each effect activates separately, resulting in you losing a total of 2 memory.
Card Q&A.q: If I have 2 copies of this Tamer in play and attack with a level 3 Digimon, do I lose 2 memory?

Effect: [Your Turn] When one of your Digimon digivolves, you may suspend this Tamer to trigger ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
[All Turns] All level 3 Digimon gain "[When Attacking] Lose 1 memory."
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
